decision: Use the deployed basketball API without changing its server
why: The service already exposes all sports data needed by the client

decision: Start from the current create-expo-app template
why: A new repository can use current SDK defaults and a routes-only src/app directory

decision: Use a local development build for simulator validation
why: The project owner requested a development build

decision: Compile the separate iOS development client locally
why: Validate the actual native dependency set before running screens
result: Xcode Debug simulator build succeeded; Expo Doctor 20/20

decision: Use saved browse league and explicit league in entity links
why: Entity ids repeat across leagues and tab history must keep the original league

decision: Use native bounded day paging instead of a custom pager state machine
why: Platform paging retains swipes with fewer independent state variables

decision: Assign the coupled client to one implementation owner
why: Schemas, query hooks, links, screens and native navigation need one consistent contract
result: Implementation running; coordinator owns builds and docs

decision: Record the rebuilt development client receipt
why: The public evidence needs to distinguish native compilation from screen behavior
result: BUILD SUCCEEDED with the native gradient module included

decision: Check all nine sports endpoints and scoreboards for four leagues independently
why: Confirm the deployed service matches the contract before client validation
result: All twelve GET requests returned HTTP 200; no live game observed

decision: Change the app icon background to deep navy
why: The project owner asked for a different background to distinguish the app
result: Navy background with the orange basketball retained

decision: Rebuild and install the development app with the navy icon
why: Native launcher artwork is generated at build time
result: Xcode build succeeded; installed; Expo Doctor 20/20

decision: Resolve link row styles before Router clones the child
why: Native testing showed callback styles were discarded and linked content stacked vertically
result: Score rows corrected; checking all game links

decision: Load native push observers only when this build supports delivery
why: The unsigned simulator emitted a native keychain error at notification module import
result: Unsupported builds defer native notification imports

decision: Express one revision-conflict retry without an unbounded for loop
why: React Compiler reported unsupported syntax for a loop without a test
result: React Doctor no longer reports a compiler error

decision: Hide the development tools overlay over trailing header actions
why: Native testing showed the overlay intercepted notifications and Done
result: Cold launch succeeded; notification modal opened from the header and Done returned to Scores
